meta.title: Account manager at a B2B software company
meta.blurb: Looks after about forty customer accounts: renewals, check-ins and expansion.

opportunities.quote: afterward I type notes and next steps into Salesforce by hand
opportunities.why: You take notes after your Zoom customer calls and turn them by hand into next steps.
opportunities.firstStep: Turn on the meeting recap for one recurring meeting and compare its action list with your own for two weeks.
opportunities.failureMode: Recaps assign actions to the wrong person when names are not said aloud.

opportunities.why: You get a high volume of customer email in Gmail and reply to each one yourself.
opportunities.firstStep: Turn on the inbox summary each morning and copy its action items into your to-do list for a week.
opportunities.failureMode: Summaries miss the one message that mattered, so important senders still need a rule that flags them.

rules.name: Task is in the task map
Quoted evidence appears word for word in the visitor's answers
Pattern is in the catalog and every required signal was recorded
Tool is listed on the pattern, with a working link checked within the limit
Hours figures are the ones code computed
A working-habit suggestion carries no hours unless the catalog supplies a share

transcript.question: About how many emails do you go through for "Triage the inbox" each day?
transcript.answer: About 60 emails a day, so I'd say 50–100.

transcript.question: For "Triage the inbox", where do most of the emails come from, and where do they go afterward?
options: Automated alerts; I file or archive them

transcript.question: How many "Customer calls" do you have in a typical week?
For "Customer calls", how do the calls get booked, and where do the outcomes go afterward?
options: Customers book; I write notes in CRM
I schedule them; notes go to my team
Manager assigns; I report back to manager
transcript.answer: I schedule them over several emails; afterward I type notes and next steps into Salesforce by hand.

transcript.question: How many sets of "Write call notes into the CRM" do you enter in a typical week?
transcript.answer: Probably more than 20, since I have customer calls most days and type notes into Salesforce after each one.
transcript.taskName: Write call notes into the CRM

transcript.question: For "Answer product questions from customers", how do the questions reach you, and who gets your answers?
options: Customers message me in Slack; I reply there
Teammates relay them in Slack; I answer teammates
Customers email; I reply by email
Questions come from calls; I answer afterward
transcript.answer: Customers message me in Slack; I reply there.
